CustomField.description: Formula-computed delivery quality status for this work order. Passed = Delivery_Quality_Check__c.Overall_Pass__c is true. Failed = Delivery_Issue_Flag__c is true. Not Required = Sod_Square_Footage__c is 0 AND Mulch_CY__c is 0 (no sod or mulch in scope). Pending = sod or mulch is in scope but Delivery_Quality_Check__c has not been submitted yet. Surfaced on work order list view, dispatcher console, and FM dashboard for pre-install status at a glance.
CustomField.formula: IF( Sod_Square_Footage__c = 0 && Mulch_CY__c = 0, "Not Required", IF( Delivery_Issue_Flag__c = TRUE, "Failed", IF( Delivery_QC_Complete__c = TRUE, "Passed", "Pending" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Delivery QC Status
